name: Wuhan Mahjong
description: Wuhan Mahjong is a Hubei regional Mahjong variant associated with Wuhan play communities. It follows the standard draw-discard structure with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while the table profile determines which hands qualify and how scoring is evaluated.

content.text: Wuhan Mahjong is a Hubei regional Mahjong variant associated with Wuhan play communities. It follows the standard draw-discard structure with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while the table profile determines which hands qualify and how scoring is evaluated.
Wuhan Mahjong grew from Chinese Mahjong traditions as local scoring expectations and table conventions formed around Wuhan and Hubei social play.
Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
